name: The One in the Lotus
source:
A Distortion to meet in [i]A Case of Missing Identity.[/i] [b]The One in the Lotus[/b] is a cold, bitter-hearted creature who speaks in poetry and does everything it can to stop itself from forming connections with its kind. Created from a young adult's loathing toward their abusive family and a deep-seated yearn to tear their skin apart, it wanders through the streets of Goldport while looking for its Tether in the hope they're no more of a monster than it is.

Despite its callous attitude toward most of the world (Distortion and Human), The One in the Lotus can't find it in itself to push Perdita away fully. As a character, it has a practical mindset, focused more on survival and making it to Completion than anything else. [i]There's no use weeping for what already has one foot in the grave.
